name: Niger (ITS, IRCM)

validation.referee: statute's own printed tables and amounts (Lean decide)
validation.notes: build phase: no referee values used; cases = Lean theorems (kernel instances and checks of the statute's printed tables and stated amounts, all proved)

sources: Code général des impôts (Loi n° 2012-37 du 20 juin 2012), DGI edition 'CGI 2013 MAJ LF 2022', archived official copy https://web.archive.org/web/20230727151430id_/https://www.impots.gouv.ne/media/telech/CGI%202013%20MAJ%20LF%20%202022.pdf

Ordonnance n° 2024-59 portant loi de finances 2025 (archived https://web.archive.org/web/20250709034954id_/https://impots.gouv.ne/media/loi/ORDONNANCE%20N%202024-59%20LOI%20DE%20FINANCES%202025..pdf): art. 11 (CGI art. 52), art. 12 (arts. 73-75 IRVM)
scale: 3600000 XOF (12 x 300 000 F, the upper limit of the 25 % monthly ITS band)
unsupported: CNSS SMIG floor (30 047 F a month) not applied; the rate décret not reached
registry_correction: NE: ITS confirmed (CGI Loi 2012-37 as amended; LF 2025 Ord. 2024-59); access B.
headline: Niger built from the 2022 consolidated CGI and the 2025 finance ordinance (LF 2023-2024 not reached): monthly ITS 1-35 % from the first franc after a 13 % abattement and a family abatement of 5-30 % of income, income rounded to 1 000 F; the 7th dependant doubles the family abatement.

w5_pattern_a.added: CNSS worker 5,25 % (retraite) of pay up to 6 000 000 F a year, deducted first under CGI art. 60 1) (6 % limit) before the 13 % abatement
w5_pattern_a.provision: CNSS "Guide de l'employeur" (Décembre 2019, cnss.ne): retraite 11,50 % = 5,25 % worker + 6,25 % employer, plafond annuel 6 000 000 F; official secondary (rate décret not reached); CGI arts. 60 1), 4)
w5_pattern_a.switch: "w5Contrib": false restores the pre-W5 outputs (0 / 300 random households differ)
